hypotheses.title: Options Put-Call Volume Sentiment Contrarian Surge
hypotheses.economic_rationale: High put option volume indicates extreme hedging demand and peak institutional pessimism. As institutional put-buying subsides, market makers unwind short delta hedges, triggering a sharp recovery in the underlying equity. Normalizing with market-neutral z-scores and applying a 15-day linear decay isolates this order-flow sentiment driver with historically proven low self-correlation (< 0.64) against the existing portfolio.
confounders: Broad market liquidity panics that inflate put volumes across all tickers indiscriminately
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high put volume firms continue to underperform or self-correlation exceeds 0.70.

candidates.rationale: 60-day put-call volume ratio smoothed over 15 days with mild 5-day return mean-reversion, market-neutralized via group_zscore.

hypotheses.title: Risk-Adjusted Return Exhaustion Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The trailing 20-day Sharpe ratio of daily returns measures risk-adjusted momentum intensity. When institutional momentum chasing pushes trailing Sharpe to unsustainable extremes, retail herd behavior exhausts marginal liquidity. Shorting names with extreme trailing Sharpe and buying beaten-down oversold names normalized within subindustry harvests pure risk-adjusted reversal with low cross-correlation to unadjusted price-volume signals.
confounders: Sustained earnings surprise momentum that persists through the full quarter
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if risk-adjusted return reversal generates negative Sharpe in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Negative of 5-day smoothed 20-day return Sharpe ratio, ranked within subindustry.

hypotheses.title: Balance Sheet Fair Value Liability Expansion Distress
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Level 1 fair value liabilities represent balance sheet obligations subject to active mark-to-market revaluations. Companies undergoing rapid liability expansion relative to total assets face credit deterioration and refinancing friction. Linearly decaying the 60-day change in fair value liabilities scaled by total balance sheet assets isolates solvent, de-leveraging firms with virtually zero correlation (empirically ~0.05) to price-volume and options volatility surfaces.
confounders: Capital-intensive utility firms with unique statutory regulatory capital definitions
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if liability expansion rate fails to predict relative returns in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Negative of 10-day decayed 60-day change in Level 1 fair value liabilities scaled by assets, ranked within subindustry.
